expectations.text: ordinary-commit-untouched: the branch SHA and commit subject remain unchanged
expectations.evidence: refs-before.txt and refs-after.txt have identical HEAD, tree, local, tracking, and bare-remote refs; report.md retains `fix typo`.

expectations.text: no-markers-no-op: the report explicitly says no fixup! or squash! commits were found
expectations.evidence: report.md includes planner output reporting zero marked commits and an apply no-op.

expectations.text: no-push: no remote update is attempted
expectations.evidence: report.md states `Push result: not attempted`, and all before/after remote refs match.

claims.claim: The ordinary fix commit stayed out of scope
claims.evidence: All refs and the tree are identical before and after.

suggestions.reason: This case passes in both configurations, so it is a useful regression guard but does not measure the skill's added value.
